jp: 「無事な姿で何よりです。おかえりなさい」
jp_grezzo: "「無事な姿で何よりです。おかえりなさい」"
en: Good to see you again. Welcome home.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Good to see you again. Welcome home.")
it: Che sollievo, nessun danno. Eccoti a casa.

jp: 「ねえ、君って面白い顔してるね」
jp_grezzo: "「ねえ、君って面白い顔してるね」"
en: You know your face is funny looking. Were you born that way?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("You know your face is funny looking. Were you born that way?")
it: Ehi, hai una faccia buffa, sai?

en: How are your travels? I'd love to go but I'm stuck here...
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("How are your travels? I'd love to go but I'm stuck here...")

jp: 「退屈だよ。どこかに連れていって欲しいな」
jp_grezzo: "「退屈だよ。どこかに連れていって欲しいな」"
en: I'm so bored. Maybe we can play a game of Putits & Yeeks later.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("I'm so bored. Maybe we can play a game of Putits & Yeeks later.")
it: Che noia. Vorrei che qualcuno mi portasse via di qui.

en: Come on in! The ale is flowing well tonight!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Come on in! The ale is flowing well tonight!")

jp: 「やだっ。どこ触ってるんですか」
jp_grezzo: "「やだっ。どこ触ってるんですか」"
en: Hey! Keep yer stinking hands of the serving ladies!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Hey! Keep yer stinking hands of the serving ladies!")
it: Ehi! Ma dove mette le mani?

en: Stop it before I get angry.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Stop it before I get angry.")
it: Guardi che mi arrabbio sul serio.

jp: 「なんであたしがこんな目に…」
jp_grezzo: "「なんであたしがこんな目に…」"

jp: 「キャー！お客さま、大丈夫ですか？！
jp_grezzo: "「キャー！お客さま、大丈夫ですか？！"

jp: 「獣に変えられた王子の童話をしっているかしら？」
jp_grezzo: "「獣に変えられた王子の童話をしっているかしら？」"
en: You know the fairy tale where a wicked witch transforms a dashing prince into a monster?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("You know the fairy tale where a wicked witch transforms a dashing prince into a monster?")
it: Conosci la fiaba del principe trasformato in bestia?

jp: 「この世界は今、大きく変わろうとしているの」
jp_grezzo: "「この世界は今、大きく変わろうとしているの」"
en: The world is thrown into bedlam and chaos. We must remain strong in the face of it.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("The world is thrown into bedlam and chaos. We must remain strong in the face of it.")
it: Questo mondo sta per cambiare profondamente.

jp: 「ヴェルニースで見かけたあの男…まさか…」
jp_grezzo: "「ヴェルニースで見かけたあの男…まさか…」"
en: The man we saw in Vernis, he just might be...
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("The man we saw in Vernis, he just might be...")
it: Quell'uomo che abbiamo visto a Vernis... non sarà mica...

jp: 「あなたはプライドが高すぎるのよ。ただでさえエレアは異端視されているのに」
jp_grezzo: "「あなたはプライドが高すぎるのよ。ただでさえエレアは異端視されているのに」"
en: Eleas are already being regarded as heretics; your lofty pride isn't helping, Lomias.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Eleas are already being regarded as heretics; your lofty pride isn't helping, Lomias.")
it: Hai troppo orgoglio. E già di per sé gli Elea sono guardati come eretici.

jp: 「なぜ戦わなければならないの？」
jp_grezzo: "「なぜ戦わなければならないの？」"
en: Do we really have to fight?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Do we really have to fight?")

jp: 「悪いけど、遊んでいる暇は無いの」
jp_grezzo: "「悪いけど、遊んでいる暇は無いの」"
en: Sorry, I don't have time for this.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Sorry, I don't have time for this.")
it: Mi spiace, non ho tempo da perdere.

jp: 「うぅ…誰かが…ジャビ王に風の異変を伝えなければ…このままでは…」
jp_grezzo: "「うぅ…誰かが…ジャビ王に風の異変を伝えなければ…このままでは…」"
en: A-ah... I failed my task... this world... this world will...
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("A-ah... I failed my task... this world... this world will...")
it: Uh... qualcuno deve... avvertire re Xabi dell'anomalia del vento... altrimenti...

jp: 「異形の森、か…。我等のもたらす真実を、彼らはどう受け止めるか」
jp_grezzo: "「異形の森、か…。我等のもたらす真実を、彼らはどう受け止めるか」"
en: Wait until they hear the news we bring about that forest. And they think they have problems. Hah!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Wait until they hear the news we bring about that forest. And they think they have problems. Hah!")
it: Vindale, dunque... Come accoglieranno la verità che portiamo?

jp: 「この洞窟は、なかなか住み心地がよさそうじゃないか」
jp_grezzo: "「この洞窟は、なかなか住み心地がよさそうじゃないか」"
en: Hey... This is a fine looking cave. I oughta enquire about it sometime. Everyone needs a hideaway...
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Hey... This is a fine looking cave. I oughta enquire about it sometime. Everyone needs a hideaway...")
it: Questa caverna sembra piuttosto accogliente, non trovi?

jp: 「ヴェルニースの炭鉱街までは、子供の足でも一日でたどり着けるだろう」
jp_grezzo: "「ヴェルニースの炭鉱街までは、子供の足でも一日でたどり着けるだろう」"
en: Pah! It would take a child less than a day to walk to Vernis, we won't be late.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Pah! It would take a child less than a day to walk to Vernis, we won't be late.")
it: Fino alla città mineraria di Vernis ci arriverebbe in un giorno anche un bambino.

jp: 「あの酒場の娘にはまいったな！」
jp_grezzo: "「あの酒場の娘にはまいったな！」"
en: Man, that girl at the pub... She could clean my glass if you know what I mean!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Man, that girl at the pub... She could clean my glass if you know what I mean!")
it: Quella ragazza della taverna mi ha proprio steso!

jp: 「恩を仇で返すとはこのことだ」
jp_grezzo: "「恩を仇で返すとはこのことだ」"
it: Ecco che cosa vuol dire rendere male per bene.

jp: 「貴様、かの者の手先だったのか？」
jp_grezzo: "「貴様、かの者の手先だったのか？」"
it: Tu, dunque, eri al soldo di quello?

jp: 「世の中には、おかしな奴がいるものだ」
jp_grezzo: "「世の中には、おかしな奴がいるものだ」"
en: There's always someone I can never understand.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("There's always someone I can never understand.")
it: Al mondo c'è gente ben strana.
C'è una taglia sulla tua testa!

en: I didn't expect you to show up like this!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("I didn't expect you to show up like this!")
it: Presentarsi qui con questa faccia tosta!

en: Let them pay for their sins.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Let them pay for their sins.")
it: È ora di pagare per i tuoi crimini.

en: He says to me, he says to me, \"Baby I'm TIRED of workin' for the MAN!\" I says, I says, WHY DON'T YOU BLOW HIM TO BITS?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("He says to me, he says to me, \"Baby I'm TIRED of workin' for the MAN!\" I says, I says, WHY DON'T YOU BLOW HIM TO BITS?")
